messages:
lucy_acct_mgr: Heads-up: ZenGuard flagged their April private deployment invoice — platform fee looks ~28% higher than projected after renewal. They want explanation before signing the amendment.
billing-bot: Invoice #ZG-2026-04, generated 2026-04-03 09:04 UTC. platform_fee_total: $39,600, support_tier: enterprise-plus, renewal_effective: 2026-04-01.
kevin_billing: Tagging FIN-4789. Did their renewal include a mid-cycle proration? Could be double-billed if renewal and monthly cycle overlapped.
olga_finance: We shouldn't block renewal but need to validate. Finance ok with a provisional goodwill credit while ops investigates.
lucy_acct_mgr: Customer says they saw both "pro-rated renewal" and a full-month platform fee on the same invoice. Procurement refusing to sign until cleared.
chris_engops: Pulling billing events for resource zg-cluster-12 for April window now. Running quick check: `SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE resource='zg-cluster-12' AND type='platform_fee' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30';`
chris_engops: result: 3 events. Two look like monthly rollups (rollup_id r-2026-04-01) and one looks like renewal_prorate event on 2026-04-01T01:12:03.
kevin_billing: can you show amounts per event? we need to identify which one is the errant duplicate.
chris_engops: `SELECT id, amount, metadata FROM billing_events WHERE resource='zg-cluster-12' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ts;` -> bf-10021: $22,000 (monthly), bf-10022: $8,800 (prorate adjustment), bf-10023: $8,800 (monthly duplicate). bf-10022 & bf-10023 identical amounts.
olga_finance: Looks like the prorate and monthly both applied for the same days. Finance approves provisional credit up to $9k pending root cause — use GL CU-CR-PROT.
kevin_billing: I'll flag invoice ZG-2026-04 as disputed and draft provisional credit memo for $8,800. Approve, @olga_finance?
olga_finance: approve provisional_credit_amount: "$8,800". Post as pending credit memo CM-ZG-2026-04-P1.
lucy_acct_mgr: I'll inform the customer: "We're investigating an overlap between renewal proration and monthly rollup. We've placed a provisional credit of $8,800 and paused collection on that line. Expect final confirmation within 72 hrs." OK?\e_kevin_billing: approve message. include ticket FIN-4789 reference for their procurement.
chris_engops: Root cause: renewal job created a prorate adjustment but did not set `skip_monthly_rollup=true` for resources that renewed on month boundary. Fix pushed (PR #4529) and a cleanup job scheduled. ENG-BILL-212 tracking.
chris_engops: Starting cleanup/backfill job backfill-zg-2181; it will remove duplicate bf-10023 if present. ETA ~4 hrs.
kevin_billing: action items: (1) ops run backfill and confirm delta (chris) (2) billing to issue provisional credit and mark invoice disputed (kevin) (3) account to notify customer (lucy) (4) finance to approve GL and final posting (olga).
chris_engops: backfill completed — removed bf-10023. delta = -$8,800. ENG-BILL-212 -> resolved.
kevin_billing: issuing credit memo CM-ZG-2026-04-1 for $8,800 and attaching to invoice ZG-2026-04. Invoice status set to adjusted.
olga_finance: Finance received GL posting request: post CU-CR-PROT $8,800 against AR ZG-2026-04. We'll sign off once CM hits ledger.
lucy_acct_mgr: Customer replied: "Thanks — procurement happy to proceed with amendment. Appreciate the quick fix." Closing loop.
kevin_billing: Postmortem items: add unit test for renewal boundary path, add a nightly check for duplicate platform_fee events, and update billing runbook. Assign owners: chris_engops, kevin_billing.
olga_finance: FIN-4789 -> closed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
